ticks.note: Tick 1 enters `ABO`, `WaitAB`, `WaitA` and `WaitB`: four states, two levels of nesting, two regions.
`B`: `HandleB` is done too, `WaitAB` terminates and its join emits `O`. `ABO` is now in `Done`.
`R`: the transition `if R abort to ABO` leaves `ABO` and enters it again, so everything inside starts over in `WaitA` and `WaitB`.
`B`: both are done, `O` is present again.
